New Angeles Hyper-Fusion Plant.kicker: The reactor that keeps New Angeles lit
text: The New Angeles Hyper-Fusion Plant powers most of New Angeles. A twisted-coil torus burns violet inside a glass sphere on a concrete drum, and three cooling towers breathe steam over the south of the city day and night.
Two high-voltage lines leave the transformer yard on lattice pylons. Locals set their clocks by the hum, and nobody builds close to the fence.
